name: Starknet Bridge

repos.scope: Indexes StarkNet StarkGate L1 bridge: StarknetMessaging contract (LogMessageToL2/ConsumedMessageToL2/LogMessageToL1) plus token-bridge deposit/withdrawal events via templated multi-bridge config.
repos.verified: Cloned repo; subgraph.template.yaml has StarknetMessaging dataSource with bridge event handlers; schema.graphql defines DepositEvent/withdrawal entities; config.template.ts lists L1/L2 bridge addresses. 7 commits, community, no recent activity.

notes: Community subgraph (kaonone). enviodev/starknet-bridge-indexer also exists but is a 1-commit blank Envio scaffold (not verified as indexing). No official StarkWare subgraph.

name: Lombard BTC.b
notes: BTC wrapper/bridge asset. lombard-finance org has SDK + evm-smart-contracts + Solana programs but no public subgraph/indexer source repo. Bridge/wrapper category - low likelihood, confirmed none.

name: Hyperliquid Spot Orderbook
notes: HyperCore is a non-EVM L1 with a native on-chain CLOB. Spot orderbook data is served via Hyperliquid API / node L1 data schemas / Kafka feeds (hyperliquid-dex/node is the chain node, not a protocol indexer). No deployable subgraph/Ponder/Envio-style public indexer repo for the spot orderbook.

name: Benqi Staked Avax
notes: sAVAX liquid staking on Avalanche. benqi-fi org has BENQI-Smart-Contracts + DefiLlama-Adapters fork only. Older references to a hosted-service subgraph (yhayun/benqithegraph) exist but no public source repo; no maintained official subgraph/indexer located.

name: Marinade Native
notes: Solana-only native staking. marinade-finance org has on-chain Anchor program + TS SDK/CLI but no public EVM-style subgraph/indexer; Solana programs are not subgraph-indexable.

name: ether.fi Liquid
notes: Liquid vaults built on Veda/BoringVault. ether.fi docs reference a deployed subgraph but no public subgraph/indexer source repo in etherfi-protocol org (only smart-contracts, cross-chain, DefiLlama-Adapters). Veda-Labs org (boring-vault) also has no public indexer/subgraph repo.

name: Marinade Liquid Staking
notes: Solana-only (mSOL). No public EVM-style subgraph/indexer; org has Anchor program + SDK only.

name: Fraxtal
notes: Chain entry (OP Stack L2), not a single indexable protocol. FraxFinance/fraxtal-node is the chain node; Fraxtal supports generic The Graph subgraph deployment (slug frax-mainnet) but there is no protocol-specific indexer repo for the chain's TVL.

name: Huma Finance V2
notes: 00labs org has huma-contracts / huma-contracts-v2, huma-monorepo (git-submodule based), huma-js SDK. SDK/docs reference a hosted subgraph for receivables/pools, but no public subgraph/indexer source repo located in the org.

name: VALR
notes: Centralized exchange; no public onchain indexer/subgraph.

name: GMX V2 Perps

repos.scope: Official GMX monorepo of subgraphs; includes 'synthetics-stats' subgraph for GMX V2 (synthetics) perps on Arbitrum & Avalanche, alongside prices/raw/stats V1 subgraphs.
repos.verified: WebFetch of repo listing confirms synthetics-stats directory (GMX V2) alongside gmx-arbitrum/avalanche stats subgraphs; 362 commits; official gmx-io org. V2 endpoints served via Satsuma (synthetics-arbitrum/avalanche-stats).

notes: Official. synthetics-stats = GMX V2 perps subgraph.

name: Tonstakers LSD
notes: TON blockchain (non-EVM) liquid staking. tonstakers org has tonstakers-sdk + DefiLlama-Adapters + ton-proxy only; no subgraph/indexer (TON not subgraph-indexable).

name: Solv Basis Trading
notes: solv-finance org has SolvBTC contracts; org repo search for subgraph/graph/indexer returns 0 results. TVL data integrated via DefiLlama adapters only. No public subgraph/indexer source repo.

name: Aerodrome Slipstream

repos.scope: Official multi-chain Envio (HyperIndex) indexer for Velodrome V2 (Optimism) and Aerodrome (Base, chain 8453), including Slipstream concentrated-liquidity pools via CLFactory/CLPool event handlers.
repos.verified: Cloned repo; config.yaml description 'Multi-chain indexer for Velodrome V2 on Optimism and Aerodrome on Base' with chain id 8453; src/EventHandlers/CLFactory.ts & CLPool.ts handle Slipstream CL pools. Pushed Jun 2026, 30 stars.

notes: Official Envio indexer shared by Velodrome/Aerodrome (type marked 'ponder' as nearest enum for the TS Envio indexer; it is HyperIndex/Envio, not Ponder). Old velodrome-finance/subgraph is archived (2023) and Velodrome-only.

name: Noble
notes: Cosmos SDK appchain for stablecoin/RWA issuance (USDC/USDN). noble-assets org has chain code (Cosmos modules) but no EVM-style subgraph/indexer; Cosmos chains are not subgraph-indexable. Chain entry, not an indexable protocol.

name: stHYPE
notes: Hyperliquid liquid staking (now run by Valantis Labs). Docs mention a public off-chain validator indexer but no public subgraph/indexer source repo; integration repo provides ABIs/frontend only. No deployable indexer located.

name: RealT Tokens

repos.verified: WebFetch: RealToken-specific fork of aave/protocol-subgraphs under realtoken-thegraph org; deployment listed as 'rmm-realt' (RealToken Money Market) on Gnosis Chain V2; updated Apr 2025.

repos.scope: Subgraph for the YAM/Swapcat secondary marketplace where RealTokens are traded on Gnosis Chain.
repos.verified: WebFetch of realtoken-thegraph org: 'Subgraph for Swapcat on Gnosis Chain' (YAM marketplace); TypeScript, updated Jul 2024.

notes: Official RealToken indexing org (realtoken-thegraph). Subgraphs cover the RMM lending market and YAM secondary marketplace where RealTokens (Gnosis-Chain RWA real-estate tokens) trade.

name: Lorenzo sUSD1+
notes: Lorenzo-Protocol org has app-chain (lorenzo/ethermint), vault contracts (lorenzo_vault_contract, enzoBTC), SDKs and DefiLlama-Adapters, but no repo with subgraph/ponder/indexer. No public indexer source located.

name: Yearn Finance

repos.verified: WebFetch confirms Kong 'comes configured with an index over Yearn Finance v2 and v3 vault ecosystems'; 376 commits; recommended by Yearn docs over subgraphs.

repos.scope: Official V2 vault subgraph (Ethereum, Fantom, Arbitrum).

notes: Official. Kong is the current actively-maintained indexer (V2+V3); the older V2 subgraph is archived.
